description: This file defines a class 'Sum' with static methods implementing various sum-related functions used in spreadsheet calculations, such as summing ignoring strings, summing with error handling, and summing products, intended for use in the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Sum
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for sum-related calculations in spreadsheet formulas.

methods.name: sumIgnoringStrings
methods.description: Calculates the sum of arguments ignoring non-numeric, non-error strings, used by SUMIF.

methods.name: sumErroringStrings
methods.description: Calculates the sum of arguments, returning error if non-numeric, non-error strings are encountered, used by Excel's SUM function.

methods.name: product
methods.description: Calculates the sum of products of multiple arrays or values, analogous to SUMPRODUCT in Excel.
